_note: Español de España; see topbar.json. Settings › AI assistants (MCP): how much an assistant may do (Off, Prepare, Prepare and run the screens), one tile per company (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok) and the other apps under Other apps, each with Add, Replace, Remove and Copy setup. App and company names (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor, VS Code, GitHub Copilot, Antigravity, Gemini, Grok Build), MCP, mcpServers and file names are names and stay as they are; {app}, {apps} and {assistant} are those names. What Copy setup copies is written to the assistant and stays English.
